custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part for this test, part A, with two or more tags.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a computer whose screen is set to 1440 pixels wide, with the browser window maximised and the page zoom at 100%.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 2.1 and 3.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839498-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839498-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with every field, the footer and its three buttons in view or reachable by scrolling inside the window.
  • The title, the green "Active" pill and the X sit on one line without touching each other.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive radio is filled blue.

Step 4:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation fits inside the screen; its lines wrap inside the dialog and every word reads in full.
  • Cancel and Deactivate sit side by side at the bottom right without overlapping.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes and the window shows Inactive still picked.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • Feature Overview, Form factor: “Parts management (the Inventory list, the part dialog and the bulk bar) is desktop and tablet. No phone layout is provided for it.”
  • S13-R2: “The title row has a thin line under it, and the close X at its right end.”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
  • S10-R11: “The confirm button reads "Deactivate" in red for a deactivation and "Activate" in blue for a reactivation. Cancel sits to its left.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
